lines.zh: 我弓着背走，弓扛在肩上。
lines.en: I walk hunched, bow over my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我踩得很轻，不想被听见。
lines.en: I step lightly, not wanting to be heard.
I hug the slope's edge, my bow silent.
I climb the slope step by step.
My quiver knocks at my hip.
I stop and find a good spot.
I stoop through the grass.
I walk backwards, facing that way.
I shift away without a sound.
I go on tiptoe; the grass doesn't bend.
I climb high for a better view.

lines.zh: 我绕了个远路，避开开阔地。
lines.en: I take a longer way around the open ground.
I pluck the bowstring once.
I count the arrows in my quiver.
I'm adjusting an arrowhead.
I crouch, still.
I bite off a frayed string end and retie it.
My long ear turns toward the sound.
I lay the bow across my knees.
I'm watching for anyone far off.
I test the string with a finger.
I remember the last shot missed.

lines.zh: 你站在空地中间，胆子不小。
lines.en: Standing in the open; bold of you.
I know that walk.
My bow is already half drawn.

lines.zh: 你手里那面盾，我看得清。
lines.en: I see that shield in your hand.
One step back and I spare an arrow.
Are you up high? Too bad.

lines.zh: 我一眼量出你到石头的步数。
lines.en: One glance tells me your paces to the rock.
My arrows are quicker than my teeth.
Stand still; moving makes it harder.
I grin, not pleasantly.
I know the tree behind you.
There's no cover between us.
I back off, hugging the bow.
My ear rings from the blow.
I drop low and look for cover.

lines.zh: 这一下打乱了我的瞄准。
lines.en: That ruined my aim.
My arm is shaking.
I bite my sleeve and swallow the sound.
I grit my teeth and nock another.
There's a tear in my quiver.
I back off behind the stone.
I can still draw the string.

lines.zh: 你身上那件甲，我瞄很久了。
lines.en: That armor of yours; I've been eyeing it.
Stand still and I shoot better.
That half of you showing; perfect.
The hand drawing the string doesn't shake.
What you hold is bright.

lines.zh: 我再靠近一点，就是必中。
lines.en: A little closer and it can't miss.
Stay right there.
My arrowhead follows you.
The wind shifted; just right.
Listen; the string sings.
You hit me, and the bow drops.
I step back and reach for an arrow.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我的箭袋翻了。
lines.en: We collide, and my quiver spills.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我抽回来。
lines.en: You step on my foot; I pull it free.
I block with the bow.
I turn and slip past you.
I press to the wall and back off.
Your shield hits my shoulder.
I stumble and drop low at once.
We part and each look for cover.

lines.zh: 另一个弓箭手在坡上等我。
lines.en: Another archer waits on the slope.
Her bow is shorter than mine.
We take turns shooting the same tree.
She counts my remaining arrows.
We set our quivers together.
Her aim is better than mine.
We crouch behind the stone together.
She lifts a hand to show the wind.
We don't need many words.
Two of us, four bags of arrows.

lines.zh: 我把射出去的箭捡回来。
lines.en: I retrieve my spent arrows.
I pick up one of your fallen arrows.
I pick up the bowstring from the ground.

lines.zh: 我把你的盾拾起来，扔远了。
lines.en: I pick up your shield and throw it far.
I pick up a rag to wipe an arrowhead.
I hang the quiver back at my hip.
I pick up a broken arrow and snap it.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的帽子捡起来。
lines.en: I retrieve the fallen hat.
I pull an arrow out of the soil.

lines.zh: 我捡起一小块铁，磨了磨。
lines.en: I pick up a bit of iron and file it.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，在空地中间。
lines.en: I see you, in the open.
Range is right, wind is right.
I raise the bow and draw slowly.
Your shoulder is exposed.
I'll loose one to test.
Staying still would be best.
I crouch low and find the angle.
Being high up won't save you.
I've worked out where it lands.
I'm aiming better than last time.
One release and the arrow flies.
Before the string sings, listen to the wind.
My fingers rest on the string.

lines.zh: 我的箭尖对着你的胸口。
lines.en: My arrowhead points at your chest.
I've chosen behind this stone.
I remember the way you walk.
I draw it a little fuller.
You go left; I move the bow left.
I measure your speed; not fast.
I wait for you to step from the tree.
I slow my breath to steady my hand.
I crouch lower.
I switch to a straighter arrow.
You're holding that shield wrong.
Three counts, then release.
You hide behind the stone; I wait.
My eyes follow you without pause.

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，顺着风偏半寸。
lines.en: I squint and aim half an inch into the wind.
I shift behind the leaning tree.
I loose one to make you move.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡住了，我改瞄腿。
lines.en: Your shield blocks; I aim lower.
I crouch with only bow and eye showing.

lines.zh: 我算你下一步会往哪躲。
lines.en: I guess where you'll dodge next.
I loose the string, and the arrow flies.
This arrow grazes your shoulder.
I draw another and shoot.
I drop the bow and charge.
I strike with the bow's limb.
I duck behind the stone and shift position.
The arrow sticks in your shield, loud.
This one finds a seam in your armor.
I shoot as I retreat.
Out of arrows; I draw a short blade.

lines.zh: 我拉满一箭，对着你的脸。
lines.en: I draw full and aim at your face.
The arrow skips off the stone.

lines.zh: 我射你的脚，让你慢下来。
lines.en: I shoot at your feet to slow you.
I duck behind the tree and nock again.
I run and shoot back over my shoulder.
This arrow cuts your rope.
I come down the slope, bow in hand.
First I scan, then find cover.
The grass is tall enough here.
I settle my quiver.
I crouch behind the stone and wait.
Today I'll loose a few more.

lines.zh: 平原上一眼能看到很远。
lines.en: On the plains you can see far.
I hear something walking.
I oil the bowstring.
I take the high ground.

lines.zh: 我把箭一支支插在脚边。
lines.en: I plant arrows at my feet.

lines.zh: 同伙在另一边，我们一起。
lines.en: My kin are on the other side; we work together.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的袖口，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve; I slap it twice.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，弓压在身下。
lines.en: I roll down the slope, my bow beneath me.
I cling to my bow as water reaches my ears.

lines.zh: 爆炸把箭袋吹开，箭撒了一地。
lines.en: The blast bursts my quiver, arrows everywhere.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我肩上，我拔出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder; I pull it out.

lines.zh: 有光缠住我的手，我拉不开弓。
lines.en: A light binds my hands; I can't draw.
Hunger makes my hands shake; I can't aim.

lines.zh: 雷打在旁边，我捂住耳朵。
lines.en: Lightning strikes nearby; I cover my ears.

lines.zh: 这里没有地，我射不出去。
lines.en: There's no ground here; nowhere to shoot from.
